dedupe_keys.name: physics based broadband simulations for earthquakeearly warning

description: Dara Goldberg and Diego Melgar publish synthetic earthquake ruptures and broadband waveforms for early-warning research. The September 2020 Zenodo archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its geographic coverage includes models of the 2014 magnitude-8.1 Iquique earthquake in Chile and simulated ruptures on the Cascadia subduction zone, with associated waveforms described as 100 Hz. The deposit identifies a study explaining the semi-stochastic rupture and synthetic P-wave methods. These inputs can support early-warning and shaking-exposure experiments for infrastructure simulations. Related catalogue record model-scec-broadband-platform provides another ground-motion simulation system; no identity or tested interchange is asserted. Exact scenario count, station geometry, file encoding, units and the meaning of the 100 Hz label were not independently established. Synthetic events do not reproduce all physical variability or operational alerting constraints. The archive was not downloaded and no waveforms were compared with observations.
